senses.gloss: m. (ניס, Saf. סניס, Ithpe. איסת׳, Ispe. איסט׳; cmp. אִיתְנִיס; cmp. אִשְׁתְּמוֹדַע as to Ishtafel) of feeble health, delicate, fastidious in diet.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 3:5">Yoma III, 5</cite> <he>איסת׳</he> Ms. a. Ar. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l., note 10; Bab. ed. mostly <cite ref="A01526"><he>איסט׳</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 100b:6">Snh. 100ᵇ</cite> (opp. <he>דעתו יפה</he> not choicy); a. fr.—Pl. <he>אִיסְתְּנִיסִים</he> &c.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 11:4">Gen. R. s. 11</cite> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="A01526"><he>איסט׳</he></cite>).
